description: Provenance for the appendix filter-tilt statement (v3.3): run_training.py's strict finite/positive-flux filter applied to the 512 local v6_cloud validation spectra; discard fraction overall and by C/O quintile (Q1=lowest C/O). Computed 2026-08-01 during the v3.3 revision (agent run, commit eade4e6); archived here because the numbers appear in the paper but were not previously persisted.

protocol.filter: all(isfinite(flux) & flux > 0) per spectrum, identical to run_training.py

caveat: Not characterized on the full perturbed (v7_opmarg) set; stated as a limitation in the paper appendix.
